description: Read the per-project ExtentosConnectionPage config (theming tokens + section visibility) the dashboard/server holds for an app. Returns { managed, config }: managed=true means the dashboard/server is the SINGLE source of truth (the SDK applies server.overlay(defaults) at render time) and the committed extentos.connection-page.json should mirror it; managed=false means UNMANAGED (committed file → code ExtentosTheme → built-in defaults). Read-only. USE to inspect what the dashboard currently drives, or before regenerateConnectionPageFile. DON'T USE to change it (use setConnectionPageConfig).

appPackage.description: The app's package / bundle id (project_install_id), e.g. com.example.myapp.

name: getConnectionPageConfig
